name: BreachNotificationQueue
purpose: Tracks suspected and confirmed personal-data incidents with a statutory notification clock, so the 72-hour window is enforced in code.
api_signature:
from typing import Protocol, Literal
from datetime import datetime

Severity = Literal['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical']

class BreachNotificationQueue(Protocol):
    def open_incident(self, detected_at: datetime, severity: Severity, summary: str) -> str: ...
    def confirm(self, incident_id: str, confirmed_at: datetime, data_classes: tuple[str, ...]) -> None: ...
    def notify_authority(self, incident_id: str, authority: str, at: datetime, reference: str) -> None: ...
    def close(self, incident_id: str, outcome: str) -> None: ...
invariants: An incident confirmed as affecting personal data MUST have a notify_authority call within 72 hours of confirmed_at; the queue SHALL emit a breach-of-SLA alert at T-24h.
open_incident MUST be callable from any service with write access to the queue; there is NEVER a gating step that delays detection recording.
Every state transition (open, confirm, notify, close) MUST emit a TamperEvidentAuditLog entry.
data_classes on confirm MUST be a non-empty tuple of PiiClassification-registered classes; empty tuples SHALL raise.
An incident CANNOT close without either a notify_authority entry or an explicit 'no_notification_required' outcome with a legal_basis field.
extension_contract: Detection sources (IDS, anomaly scoring, manual reports) call open_incident. Notification channel plugins (DPA portal adapters, HHS OCR form submitters) subscribe to the notify phase and register themselves as NotificationChannel implementations.

sources.locator: Article 33 notification of personal data breach to supervisory authority within 72 hours

why_essential: Incident trackers in ticketing tools have no statutory clock; a domain-specific queue makes the 72-hour GDPR window and HIPAA incident response requirement computable and alertable.
alternatives_considered: Generic Jira project for incidents — no statutory clock, no authority-notification tracking.
PagerDuty postmortems — operational focus, not regulatory evidence.
Email distribution list — untracked, non-reproducible state.
